title: 门店净销售、利润与目标达成
issue: 最新结构、业务口径、主库及现有独立场景复核通过；重新计算预期结果。

before.requirements: 每门店一行；有效线下订单，按原订单日期归属截至年底退货；毛利=净销售-退货冲减后成本；毛利率和目标达成率使用百分比，分母为0返回NULL；金额单位分。保留无销售门店。
before.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT store_id,SUM(net_cents) net,SUM(cost_cents) cost FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY store_id), b AS (SELECT store_id,SUM(target_cents) target FROM sales_targets WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY store_id) SELECT s.store_id,COALESCE(a.net,0) net_cents,COALESCE(a.net-a.cost,0) gross_cents,ROUND(100.0*(a.net-a.cost)/NULLIF(a.net,0),2) margin_pct,b.target target_cents,ROUND(100.0*COALESCE(a.net,0)/NULLIF(b.target,0),2) achievement_pct FROM stores s LEFT JOIN a ON a.store_id=s.store_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.store_id=s.store_id ORDER BY s.store_id

question: q0252
originalTitle: 门店月度环比同比与持续下滑
title: 门店月度环比同比与持续下滑
issue: 最新结构、业务口径、主库及现有独立场景复核通过；重新计算预期结果。

before.requirements: 构造2023—2025完整门店月份轴；2025年逐月返回净销售、环比、同比及连续三月负增长标志；上期零或缺失时比率NULL。
before.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT DISTINCT month_key FROM calendar_days WHERE day<='2025-12-31'), a AS (SELECT store_id,SUBSTR(order_date,1,7) m,SUM(net_cents) net FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' GROUP BY store_id,SUBSTR(order_date,1,7)), b AS (SELECT s.store_id,m.month_key,COALESCE(a.net,0) net FROM stores s CROSS JOIN m LEFT JOIN a ON a.store_id=s.store_id AND a.m=m.month_key), p AS (SELECT *,LAG(net) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key) prev,LAG(net,12) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key) prior_year FROM b), q AS (SELECT *,CASE WHEN prev>0 AND net<prev THEN 1 ELSE 0 END falling FROM p), z AS (SELECT *,SUM(falling) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) fall3 FROM q) SELECT store_id,month_key,net net_cents,ROUND(100.0*(net-prev)/NULLIF(prev,0),2) mom_pct,ROUND(100.0*(net-prior_year)/NULLIF(prior_year,0),2) yoy_pct,CASE WHEN fall3=3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END three_declines FROM z WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' ORDER BY store_id,month_key

after.requirements: 2025年第四季度线下门店，保留全部门店。输出净销售、毛利率、目标达成率、退款率及净销售RANK排名。以所有门店汇总后的加权指标为比较基准，不能平均各店比率。三项复核标记分别为毛利率低于整体毛利率1个百分点、达成率低于整体达成率的80%、退款率高于整体退款率的125%。整体达成率仅纳入目标金额为正的门店，分子也使用这些门店的净销售。退款率=退款额/退款前折后销售额。基准或门店比率分母为0时为NULL，该项不计标记。标记使用未舍入值，输出比率保留2位小数。按标记数降序、门店编号升序，排名并列保留空位。该表是相对经营复核名单，不代表公司已达到年度预算。
after.sql:
WITH a AS (
  SELECT store_id, SUM(net_cents) net, SUM(cost_cents) cost, SUM(refund_cents) refund
  FROM v_sales_lines
  WHERE channel='store' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-10-01' AND '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY store_id
), b AS (
  SELECT store_id, SUM(target_cents) target FROM sales_targets
  WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-10' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY store_id
), p AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, COALESCE(a.net,0) net, COALESCE(a.cost,0) cost,
    COALESCE(a.refund,0) refund, b.target,
    100.0*(a.net-a.cost)/NULLIF(a.net,0) margin,
    100.0*COALESCE(a.net,0)/NULLIF(b.target,0) attainment,
    100.0*a.refund/NULLIF(a.net+a.refund,0) refund_rate
  FROM stores s LEFT JOIN a ON a.store_id=s.store_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.store_id=s.store_id
), benchmark AS (
  SELECT 100.0*SUM(net-cost)/NULLIF(SUM(net),0) margin,
    100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN target>0 THEN net ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN target>0 THEN target ELSE 0 END),0) attainment,
    100.0*SUM(refund)/NULLIF(SUM(net+refund),0) refund_rate FROM p
), z AS (
  SELECT p.*,
    CASE WHEN p.margin<benchmark.margin-1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    +CASE WHEN p.attainment<benchmark.attainment*.8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    +CASE WHEN p.refund_rate>benchmark.refund_rate*1.25 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END flags,
    RANK() OVER(ORDER BY net DESC) sales_rank FROM p CROSS JOIN benchmark
)
SELECT store_id, net net_cents, ROUND(margin,2) margin_pct,
  ROUND(attainment,2) achievement_pct, ROUND(refund_rate,2) refund_pct, flags, sales_rank
FROM z ORDER BY flags DESC,store_id

before.requirements: 截止2025年底，近30天销售出库速度；供应商历史实际收货周期按合格收货量加权（使用完整2025年收货记录），无记录则14天；预计需要库存=日均出库×历史周期；仅有效商品且预计需求超过当前库存。
before.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT warehouse_id,product_id,SUM(-quantity_delta) sold FROM stock_movements WHERE movement_type='sale' AND movement_date BETWEEN '2025-12-02' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY warehouse_id,product_id), l AS (SELECT p.warehouse_id,i.product_id,SUM((b.day_index-a.day_index)*(g.quantity_received-g.quantity_rejected))*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(g.quantity_received-g.quantity_rejected),0) lead_days FROM goods_receipts g JOIN purchase_order_items i ON i.po_item_id=g.po_item_id JOIN purchase_orders p ON p.po_id=i.po_id JOIN calendar_days a ON a.day=p.order_date JOIN calendar_days b ON b.day=g.receipt_date WHERE g.receipt_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY p.warehouse_id,i.product_id), z AS (SELECT i.warehouse_id,i.product_id,i.quantity,COALESCE(s.sold,0) sold,COALESCE(l.lead_days,14) lead_days FROM inventory_snapshots i JOIN products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id LEFT JOIN s ON s.warehouse_id=i.warehouse_id AND s.product_id=i.product_id LEFT JOIN l ON l.warehouse_id=i.warehouse_id AND l.product_id=i.product_id WHERE i.snapshot_date='2025-12-31' AND p.active=1) SELECT warehouse_id,product_id,quantity,sold,ROUND(lead_days,2) lead_days,ROUND(sold*lead_days/30.0-quantity,2) expected_shortage FROM z WHERE sold*lead_days/30.0>quantity ORDER BY expected_shortage DESC,warehouse_id,product_id

title: 补货优先级与商品历史履约风险
issue: 标题写供应商风险，实际输出为仓库商品在多个供应商上的合并履约率，且采购行等权口径未明确。 旧企业任务阅读版记载68行，最新实际结果为69行，已同步导出。 旧企业任务阅读版参考SQL在最新主库或隐藏场景不成立，已替换为当前验证代码。

before.requirements: 期末，未来30天需求=近30天实际销售出库量；在途=未取消且承诺日在2026-01-01至2026-01-30内、且未完成采购的剩余数量；履约风险用对应商品历史采购准时足量率（承诺日已到且非取消），缺失NULL；对有效商品计算缺口、库存金额、供应商风险，按缺口降序。 更远承诺日期的在途不用于抵扣当前30日补货缺口。
before.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT warehouse_id,product_id,SUM(-quantity_delta) sold FROM stock_movements WHERE movement_type='sale' AND movement_date BETWEEN '2025-12-02' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY warehouse_id,product_id), p AS (SELECT warehouse_id,product_id,SUM(CASE WHEN promised_date>'2025-12-31' AND promised_date<='2026-01-30' AND quantity_ordered>accepted THEN quantity_ordered-accepted ELSE 0 END) inbound,SUM(CASE WHEN promised_date<='2025-12-31' AND on_time>=quantity_ordered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) good,SUM(CASE WHEN promised_date<='2025-12-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) due FROM v_po_lines GROUP BY warehouse_id,product_id), z AS (SELECT i.warehouse_id,i.product_id,i.quantity,i.quantity*i.unit_cost_cents stock_value_cents,COALESCE(s.sold,0) demand,COALESCE(p.inbound,0) inbound,100.0*p.good/NULLIF(p.due,0) reliability FROM inventory_snapshots i JOIN products a ON a.product_id=i.product_id LEFT JOIN s ON s.warehouse_id=i.warehouse_id AND s.product_id=i.product_id LEFT JOIN p ON p.warehouse_id=i.warehouse_id AND p.product_id=i.product_id WHERE i.snapshot_date='2025-12-31' AND a.active=1) SELECT warehouse_id,product_id,quantity,stock_value_cents,demand,inbound,demand-quantity-inbound shortage,ROUND(reliability,2) reliability_pct FROM z WHERE demand>quantity+inbound ORDER BY shortage DESC,warehouse_id,product_id

title: 首购月份留存矩阵
issue: 最新结构、业务口径、主库及现有独立场景复核通过；重新计算预期结果。

before.requirements: 线上有效订单；首次购买月为同期群，观察第0至第6月；按首购月与月偏移输出同期群规模、活跃客户与留存率；没有活跃但已观察的月份为0，未来月份不输出。
before.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT customer_id,MIN(SUBSTR(order_date,1,7)) cohort FROM v_order_net WHERE channel='online' GROUP BY customer_id), b AS (SELECT cohort,COUNT(*) n FROM a GROUP BY cohort), m AS (SELECT DISTINCT month_key FROM calendar_days WHERE day<='2025-12-31'), x AS (SELECT b.cohort,m.month_key,b.n,(CAST(SUBSTR(m.month_key,1,4) AS INTEGER)-CAST(SUBSTR(b.cohort,1,4) AS INTEGER))*12+CAST(SUBSTR(m.month_key,6,2) AS INTEGER)-CAST(SUBSTR(b.cohort,6,2) AS INTEGER) k FROM b CROSS JOIN m WHERE m.month_key>=b.cohort), y AS (SELECT a.cohort,SUBSTR(o.order_date,1,7) m,COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) active FROM a JOIN v_order_net o ON o.customer_id=a.customer_id AND o.channel='online' GROUP BY a.cohort,SUBSTR(o.order_date,1,7)) SELECT x.cohort,x.k month_offset,x.n cohort_size,COALESCE(y.active,0) active_customers,ROUND(100.0*COALESCE(y.active,0)/x.n,2) retention_pct FROM x LEFT JOIN y ON y.cohort=x.cohort AND y.m=x.month_key WHERE x.k BETWEEN 0 AND 6 ORDER BY x.cohort,x.k

before.requirements: 2025年，按访问渠道归因；转化率=有有效订单的不同会话数/会话数；新客数只计历史首次线上有效订单；获客成本=渠道广告支出/新客数；净收入广告回报=净销售/广告支出；零分母NULL。

before.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT reference_no ref,SUM(expense_cents) ledger FROM v_expenses WHERE entry_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY reference_no), b AS (SELECT COALESCE(reference_no,CONCAT('BANK-',bank_id)) ref,SUM(-amount_cents) bank FROM bank_transactions WHERE transaction_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY COALESCE(reference_no,CONCAT('BANK-',bank_id))), k AS (SELECT ref FROM a UNION SELECT ref FROM b) SELECT k.ref,a.ledger ledger_cents,b.bank bank_cents,COALESCE(b.bank,0)-COALESCE(a.ledger,0) difference_cents,CASE WHEN a.ref IS NULL THEN 'bank_only' WHEN b.ref IS NULL THEN 'ledger_only' ELSE 'difference' END issue FROM k LEFT JOIN a ON a.ref=k.ref LEFT JOIN b ON b.ref=k.ref WHERE a.ref IS NULL OR b.ref IS NULL OR a.ledger<>b.bank ORDER BY k.ref

after.requirements: 2025年费用凭证按真实reference_no汇总费用净额；银行按真实reference_no汇总净支出，净支出=-SUM(amount_cents)，正向冲回或收入作为负支出，不能逐行取ABS。采用两端全量键集合，每条NULL银行参考号单独对账，并用reference_kind区分reference与unreferenced_bank，防止合成显示名BANK-编号与真实参考号碰撞。返回有缺失或金额差异的记录，差额=银行净支出-账簿费用；缺失端输出NULL。显示ref为真实参考号或BANK-银行编号。按ref升序、reference_kind升序。
after.sql:
WITH a AS (
  SELECT 0 unreferenced, reference_no ref, SUM(expense_cents) ledger
  FROM v_expenses WHERE entry_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY reference_no
), b AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN reference_no IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END unreferenced,
    COALESCE(reference_no,CAST(bank_id AS CHAR)) ref, SUM(-amount_cents) bank
  FROM bank_transactions WHERE transaction_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY CASE WHEN reference_no IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,COALESCE(reference_no,CAST(bank_id AS CHAR))
), k AS (
  SELECT unreferenced,ref FROM a UNION SELECT unreferenced,ref FROM b
)
SELECT CASE WHEN k.unreferenced=1 THEN CONCAT('BANK-',k.ref) ELSE k.ref END ref,
  a.ledger ledger_cents,b.bank bank_cents,COALESCE(b.bank,0)-COALESCE(a.ledger,0) difference_cents,
  CASE WHEN a.ref IS NULL THEN 'bank_only' WHEN b.ref IS NULL THEN 'ledger_only' ELSE 'difference' END issue,
  CASE WHEN k.unreferenced=1 THEN 'unreferenced_bank' ELSE 'reference' END reference_kind
FROM k LEFT JOIN a ON a.ref=k.ref AND a.unreferenced=k.unreferenced
LEFT JOIN b ON b.ref=k.ref AND b.unreferenced=k.unreferenced
WHERE a.ref IS NULL OR b.ref IS NULL OR a.ledger<>b.bank ORDER BY ref,reference_kind

before.requirements: 以首次任职部门为入职部门；按入职季度与部门分组；只纳入截至2025年底已有90/180日观察期的员工；终止日等于观察日算不在职；返回两个分母和留任率。

originalTitle: 逾期在途与缺货叠加
title: 逾期在途与缺货叠加
issue: 最新结构、业务口径、主库及现有独立场景复核通过；重新计算预期结果。 旧企业任务阅读版记载32行，最新实际结果为23行，已同步导出。

before.requirements: 截止2025年底，将已到期未足量收货采购行按仓库商品汇总；结合当前库存和近30日销量，筛选库存低于30日需求且逾期未收货量>0的商品。
before.sql: WITH p AS (SELECT warehouse_id,product_id,SUM(quantity_ordered-accepted) overdue FROM v_po_lines WHERE promised_date<='2025-12-31' AND accepted<quantity_ordered GROUP BY warehouse_id,product_id), s AS (SELECT warehouse_id,product_id,SUM(-quantity_delta) sold FROM stock_movements WHERE movement_type='sale' AND movement_date BETWEEN '2025-12-02' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY warehouse_id,product_id) SELECT i.warehouse_id,i.product_id,i.quantity,s.sold demand,p.overdue overdue_units,s.sold-i.quantity shortage FROM inventory_snapshots i JOIN p ON p.warehouse_id=i.warehouse_id AND p.product_id=i.product_id JOIN s ON s.warehouse_id=i.warehouse_id AND s.product_id=i.product_id WHERE i.snapshot_date='2025-12-31' AND i.quantity<s.sold ORDER BY shortage DESC,i.warehouse_id,i.product_id

title: 收货入库完整性核对

originalTitle: 门店贡献利润与费用
title: 门店贡献利润与费用
issue: 最新结构、业务口径、主库及现有独立场景复核通过；重新计算预期结果。

before.requirements: 2025年线下每门店，净销售-销售成本-归属于门店的费用分录作为贡献利润（未扣人工与总部费用，非净利润）；保留所有门店，输出贡献率。
before.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT store_id,SUM(net_cents) net,SUM(cost_cents) cost FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY store_id), b AS (SELECT store_id,SUM(expense_cents) expense FROM v_expenses WHERE entry_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' AND store_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY store_id) SELECT s.store_id,COALESCE(a.net,0) net_cents,COALESCE(a.cost,0) cost_cents,COALESCE(b.expense,0) expense_cents,COALESCE(a.net-a.cost,0)-COALESCE(b.expense,0) contribution_cents,ROUND(100.0*(COALESCE(a.net-a.cost,0)-COALESCE(b.expense,0))/NULLIF(a.net,0),2) contribution_pct FROM stores s LEFT JOIN a ON a.store_id=s.store_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.store_id=s.store_id ORDER BY contribution_cents DESC,s.store_id

issue: 最新结构、业务口径、主库及现有独立场景复核通过；重新计算预期结果。 旧企业任务阅读版参考SQL在最新主库或隐藏场景不成立，已替换为当前验证代码。

before.requirements: 2025年每店每月，净销售、费用、费用率及过去3个月费用率（总费用/总净销售）；至少三个月才输出滚动率，缺失月份销售费用为0。 三个月滚动指标包含2024年11—12月历史后再筛选2025年输出，不在年度边界重新开始累计；确实不足三个月时返回NULL。

title: 采购承诺、收货、开票及付款敞口
issue: 最新结构、业务口径、主库及现有独立场景复核通过；重新计算预期结果。

before.requirements: 截至2025年底每供应商，采购订单金额、实际合格收货计价、发票金额、实付及未付余额；两套数据分别按供应商汇总，保留无采购供应商。 本库v_invoice_balance的billed_cents为发票面额减截至截止日已批准贷项后的净应付，paid_cents仅计截止日前付款；原始发票面额保留在supplier_invoice_items。
before.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT supplier_id,SUM(ordered_cents) ordered,SUM(accepted*unit_price_cents) received FROM v_po_lines GROUP BY supplier_id), b AS (SELECT supplier_id,SUM(billed_cents) billed,SUM(paid_cents) paid,SUM(balance_cents) balance FROM v_invoice_balance GROUP BY supplier_id) SELECT s.supplier_id,COALESCE(a.ordered,0) ordered_cents,COALESCE(a.received,0) received_cents,COALESCE(b.billed,0) billed_cents,COALESCE(b.paid,0) paid_cents,COALESCE(b.balance,0) balance_cents FROM suppliers s LEFT JOIN a ON a.supplier_id=s.supplier_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.supplier_id=s.supplier_id ORDER BY balance_cents DESC,s.supplier_id

after.requirements: 截至2025-12-31，筛选已发生付款且净应付与可分配合格收货计价金额差的绝对值超过100分的发票。先按采购行汇总截止日合格收货量，再按发票日期、发票编号、发票行编号依次将该采购行收货量分配给已开票数量，每行分配量=min(本行开票量,max(合格收货总量-更早发票行累计开票量,0))，同一收货量只能分配一次。每张发票received_cents为分配量乘原采购行单价之和。净应付billed_cents扣截至截止日批准贷项，paid_cents仅计截止日前实付。返回净应付减可分配金额以及实付减可分配金额，差额可为正或负；不能把所有差额都称为超付。按账单差额绝对值降序、发票编号升序。分配是期末复核口径，包含截至年底的后续收货，不代表付款日当时已收货，也不自动判定欺诈。
after.sql:
WITH receipts AS (
  SELECT po_item_id,SUM(quantity_received-quantity_rejected) accepted
  FROM goods_receipts WHERE receipt_date<='2025-12-31' GROUP BY po_item_id
), lines AS (
  SELECT x.*,p.unit_price_cents po_price,COALESCE(r.accepted,0) accepted,
    COALESCE(SUM(x.quantity_billed) OVER(PARTITION BY x.po_item_id
      ORDER BY f.invoice_date,f.supplier_invoice_id,x.supplier_invoice_item_id
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING),0) prior_billed
  FROM supplier_invoice_items x JOIN supplier_invoices f ON f.supplier_invoice_id=x.supplier_invoice_id
  JOIN purchase_order_items p ON p.po_item_id=x.po_item_id LEFT JOIN receipts r ON r.po_item_id=x.po_item_id
  WHERE f.invoice_date<='2025-12-31'
), allocated AS (
  SELECT supplier_invoice_id,SUM(CASE WHEN accepted<=prior_billed THEN 0
    WHEN accepted-prior_billed>=quantity_billed THEN quantity_billed
    ELSE accepted-prior_billed END*po_price) received FROM lines GROUP BY supplier_invoice_id
)
SELECT b.supplier_invoice_id,b.po_id,b.billed_cents,b.paid_cents,a.received received_cents,
  b.billed_cents-a.received bill_difference_cents,b.paid_cents-a.received paid_difference_cents
FROM v_invoice_balance b JOIN allocated a ON a.supplier_invoice_id=b.supplier_invoice_id
WHERE b.paid_cents>0 AND ABS(b.billed_cents-a.received)>100
ORDER BY ABS(b.billed_cents-a.received) DESC,b.supplier_invoice_id

    IFNULL(SUM(x.quantity_billed) OVER(PARTITION BY x.po_item_id
      ORDER BY f.invoice_date,f.supplier_invoice_id,x.supplier_invoice_item_id
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING),0) prior_billed
  FROM supplier_invoice_items x JOIN supplier_invoices f ON f.supplier_invoice_id=x.supplier_invoice_id
  JOIN purchase_order_items p ON p.po_item_id=x.po_item_id LEFT JOIN receipts r ON r.po_item_id=x.po_item_id
  WHERE f.invoice_date<='2025-12-31'

  SELECT supplier_invoice_id,SUM(CASE WHEN accepted<=prior_billed THEN 0
    WHEN accepted-prior_billed>=quantity_billed THEN quantity_billed
    ELSE accepted-prior_billed END*po_price) received FROM lines GROUP BY supplier_invoice_id
)

  b.billed_cents-a.received bill_difference_cents,b.paid_cents-a.received paid_difference_cents
FROM v_invoice_balance b JOIN allocated a ON a.supplier_invoice_id=b.supplier_invoice_id
WHERE b.paid_cents>0 AND ABS(b.billed_cents-a.received)>100
ORDER BY ABS(b.billed_cents-a.received) DESC,b.supplier_invoice_id

before.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT month_key,MAX(day) last_day FROM calendar_days WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2024-12' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY month_key), h AS (SELECT s.store_id,m.month_key,COUNT(e.employee_id) headcount FROM stores s CROSS JOIN m LEFT JOIN employment_history e ON e.store_id=s.store_id AND e.start_date<=m.last_day AND (e.end_date IS NULL OR e.end_date>m.last_day) GROUP BY s.store_id,m.month_key), a AS (SELECT store_id,SUBSTR(order_date,1,7) m,SUM(net_cents) net FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' AND order_date>='2024-12-01' GROUP BY store_id,SUBSTR(order_date,1,7)), z AS (SELECT h.*,COALESCE(a.net,0) net FROM h LEFT JOIN a ON a.store_id=h.store_id AND a.m=h.month_key), p AS (SELECT *,LAG(headcount) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key) prev_h,LAG(net) OVER(PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY month_key) prev_net FROM z) SELECT store_id,month_key,headcount,net net_cents,ROUND(100.0*(headcount-prev_h)/NULLIF(prev_h,0),2) headcount_change_pct,ROUND(100.0*(net-prev_net)/NULLIF(prev_net,0),2) sales_change_pct,CASE WHEN headcount>prev_h AND net<prev_net THEN 1 ELSE 0 END review_flag FROM p WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12' ORDER BY store_id,month_key

issue: 四个季度旧风险数全部为3，费用率和人工率固定阈值全部触发；期末库存按整月求和会误纳入月内其他快照，缺失统计范围不明确。 旧企业任务阅读版参考SQL在最新主库或隐藏场景不成立，已替换为当前验证代码。

before.requirements: 2025年每季度，计算毛利率、费用率、人工率、供应商准时足量率、期末库存资金；风险项为毛利率<30%、费用率>50%、人工率>20%、履约<60%；保留所有季度，缺失不计风险并显示缺失指标数。使用月份映射，不将采购承诺算费用。
before.sql: WITH qm AS (SELECT DISTINCT month_key,CONCAT(SUBSTR(month_key,1,4),'-Q',CASE WHEN SUBSTR(month_key,6,2)<='03' THEN '1' WHEN SUBSTR(month_key,6,2)<='06' THEN '2' WHEN SUBSTR(month_key,6,2)<='09' THEN '3' ELSE '4' END) q FROM calendar_days WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-12'), qs AS (SELECT q,MAX(month_key) end_m FROM qm GROUP BY q), s AS (SELECT qm.q,SUM(v.net_cents) net,SUM(v.net_cents-v.cost_cents) gross FROM v_sales_lines v JOIN qm ON qm.month_key=SUBSTR(v.order_date,1,7) GROUP BY qm.q), f AS (SELECT qm.q,SUM(v.expense_cents) expense FROM v_expenses v JOIN qm ON qm.month_key=SUBSTR(v.entry_date,1,7) GROUP BY qm.q), h AS (SELECT qm.q,SUM(v.labor_cents) labor FROM v_staff_month v JOIN qm ON qm.month_key=v.month_key GROUP BY qm.q), p AS (SELECT qm.q,COUNT(*) n,SUM(CASE WHEN v.on_time>=v.quantity_ordered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) good FROM v_po_lines v JOIN qm ON qm.month_key=SUBSTR(v.promised_date,1,7) GROUP BY qm.q), i AS (SELECT SUBSTR(snapshot_date,1,7) m,SUM(quantity*unit_cost_cents) stock FROM inventory_snapshots GROUP BY SUBSTR(snapshot_date,1,7)), z AS (SELECT qs.q,s.net,100.0*s.gross/NULLIF(s.net,0) margin,100.0*COALESCE(f.expense,0)/NULLIF(s.net,0) expense_pct,100.0*COALESCE(h.labor,0)/NULLIF(s.net,0) labor_pct,100.0*p.good/NULLIF(p.n,0) delivery,i.stock FROM qs LEFT JOIN s ON s.q=qs.q LEFT JOIN f ON f.q=qs.q LEFT JOIN h ON h.q=qs.q LEFT JOIN p ON p.q=qs.q LEFT JOIN i ON i.m=qs.end_m) SELECT q,net net_cents,ROUND(margin,2) margin_pct,ROUND(expense_pct,2) expense_pct,ROUND(labor_pct,2) labor_pct,ROUND(delivery,2) delivery_pct,stock stock_cents,CASE WHEN margin<30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END+CASE WHEN expense_pct>50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END+CASE WHEN labor_pct>20 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END+CASE WHEN delivery<60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END risk_count,CASE WHEN margin IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END+CASE WHEN expense_pct IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END+CASE WHEN labor_pct IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END+CASE WHEN delivery IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END missing_count FROM z ORDER BY q

after.requirements: 2025年每季度跨域报告，与2024年同季度比较。输出本期净销售、毛利率、费用率、人工率、2025年到期采购行准时足量率和准确季度末库存标准价值。三项同比变化按本期比率减2024年同期比率，单位为百分点。风险项为毛利率同比下降超过3个百分点、费用率同比上升超过10个百分点、人工率同比上升超过10个百分点、当期准时足量率低于60%。以未舍入比率判定，指标显示2位小数，保留四个季度。零分母或缺失同比基准返回NULL，该项不计风险。missing_count统计三项同比变化、当期履约率及季度末库存价值这五项的NULL数。期末库存仅取季度最后一个自然日，任何仓库商品组合缺少该日快照时总库存价值为NULL，不能把缺失当0或累计整个月快照。费用、人工、销售和采购各自汇总后再连接；采购承诺不计费用。风险阈值用于教学复核，不是审计结论。

WITH qm AS (
  SELECT month_key,CONCAT(SUBSTR(month_key,1,4),'-Q',
    CASE WHEN SUBSTR(month_key,6,2)<='03' THEN '1' WHEN SUBSTR(month_key,6,2)<='06' THEN '2'
      WHEN SUBSTR(month_key,6,2)<='09' THEN '3' ELSE '4' END) q,MAX(day) month_end
  FROM calendar_days WHERE month_key BETWEEN '2024-01' AND '2025-12' GROUP BY month_key
), qs AS (
  SELECT q,MAX(month_end) end_day FROM qm GROUP BY q
), s AS (
  SELECT qm.q,SUM(v.net_cents) net,SUM(v.net_cents-v.cost_cents) gross
  FROM v_sales_lines v JOIN qm ON qm.month_key=SUBSTR(v.order_date,1,7) GROUP BY qm.q
), f AS (
  SELECT qm.q,SUM(v.expense_cents) expense FROM v_expenses v
  JOIN qm ON qm.month_key=SUBSTR(v.entry_date,1,7) GROUP BY qm.q
), h AS (
  SELECT qm.q,SUM(v.labor_cents) labor FROM v_staff_month v
  JOIN qm ON qm.month_key=v.month_key GROUP BY qm.q
), p AS (
  SELECT qm.q,COUNT(*) n,SUM(CASE WHEN v.on_time>=v.quantity_ordered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) good
  FROM v_po_lines v JOIN qm ON qm.month_key=SUBSTR(v.promised_date,1,7) GROUP BY qm.q
), i AS (
  SELECT qs.q,CASE WHEN COUNT(x.snapshot_id)=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products)*(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM warehouses)
    THEN SUM(x.quantity*x.unit_cost_cents) ELSE NULL END stock
  FROM qs LEFT JOIN inventory_snapshots x ON x.snapshot_date=qs.end_day GROUP BY qs.q
), metrics AS (
  SELECT qs.q,s.net,100.0*s.gross/NULLIF(s.net,0) margin,
    100.0*COALESCE(f.expense,0)/NULLIF(s.net,0) expense_pct,
    100.0*COALESCE(h.labor,0)/NULLIF(s.net,0) labor_pct,
    100.0*p.good/NULLIF(p.n,0) delivery,i.stock FROM qs
  LEFT JOIN s ON s.q=qs.q LEFT JOIN f ON f.q=qs.q LEFT JOIN h ON h.q=qs.q
  LEFT JOIN p ON p.q=qs.q LEFT JOIN i ON i.q=qs.q
), compared AS (
  SELECT a.*,a.margin-b.margin margin_change,a.expense_pct-b.expense_pct expense_change,
    a.labor_pct-b.labor_pct labor_change FROM metrics a
  LEFT JOIN metrics b ON b.q=CONCAT('2024',SUBSTR(a.q,5)) WHERE a.q BETWEEN '2025-Q1' AND '2025-Q4'
)
SELECT q,net net_cents,ROUND(margin,2) margin_pct,ROUND(expense_pct,2) expense_pct,
  ROUND(labor_pct,2) labor_pct,ROUND(delivery,2) delivery_pct,stock stock_cents,
  ROUND(margin_change,2) margin_change_points,ROUND(expense_change,2) expense_change_points,
  ROUND(labor_change,2) labor_change_points,
  CASE WHEN margin_change < -3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END+CASE WHEN expense_change>10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    +CASE WHEN labor_change>10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END+CASE WHEN delivery<60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END risk_count,
  CASE WHEN margin_change IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END+CASE WHEN expense_change IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    +CASE WHEN labor_change IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END+CASE WHEN delivery IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    +CASE WHEN stock IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END missing_count
FROM compared ORDER BY q
